items: A dormant-alias sweep once deleted a legal intake address that was still the published contact on a records request, and the requests silently dropped.
Legal owns its intake addresses end to end, so when one shows up on a cleanup sheet I want their owner to confirm it really is retired.
Product and vendor aliases are easy to judge from a destinations check, but a quiet legal intake alias can look dormant and still be load-bearing.
Our quarterly dormant-alias sheet is reviewed by each alias owner, including legal, before the cleanup cycle starts.
Legal already migrated records-intake to a current address and confirmed the old intake alias is decommissioned and safe to remove.
When a destinations check shows an alias on the sheet has no live routing left, that row is a pre-cleared deletion for this cycle.
